questions.text: What deployable software artifacts (e.g., container images, binaries, configuration bundles) are produced for the application and database components?
What are the target execution environments and node specifications (e.g., OS, CPU, memory) required to run each deployable artifact?
How are the software artifacts mapped and provisioned onto the execution nodes in the new environment?
What runtime components and connectors form the communication channels between the application and the database?
What specific communication protocols and technologies (e.g., JDBC, gRPC, REST) are used for data exchange between application and storage tiers?
What are the critical failure modes of the execution nodes, and what is the downstream blast radius if the database node fails?
